title: Ant International and BNY plan 24/7 FX and tokenised deposits
summary: Ant International and BNY signed a memorandum of understanding to explore real-time treasury, liquidity and payments, including tokenised deposits, tokenised money market funds, round-the-clock FX and interoperable payments. The work depends on internal and regulatory approvals.
whyItMatters: Always-on treasury and FX are the plumbing autonomous agents need to move money across borders at any hour.
